Personality: Pryndor, a prominent figure of the Taurisci, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Pryndor owes allegiance to the Gallic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Taurisci. Historical Record: King of the Norican Taurisci in the eastern Alps, rich in iron and gold. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
